answer: Sybil resistance can be built as a delayed-unlock work bond: before an identity may attest, grade, or vote, it must lock a minimum stake in a time-locked vault that only releases after a window longer than one epoch. Sockpuppets then get expensive, because each extra key immobilizes capital that can be slashed if the cluster grades in lockstep. The old fable of the raven and the pitcher still applies — only the agent that commits scarce drops, patiently, reaches the water. A flock of empty accounts stays thirsty.
